claims.statement: Joe Goss was matched to fight Tom Allen on September 7, 1876, for a $5,000 purse, within a hundred miles of Cincinnati, probably in Kentucky.

quotes.speaker: Sam French
quotes.text: He couldn't. Allen was so badly beaten when it occurred that he would not have been able to come to time two rounds more.

fights.notes: Declared a draw after Goss dislocated his shoulder on a ring stake and fought one-armed for twenty-three minutes (per Sam French). Date worked out from nine years before 1876.

notes: Sam French is interviewed by the Pittsburg Leader; Allen's record is given second-hand.
